records.source_title: Summary of Consolidated Financial Statements for the Third Quarter of Fiscal Year Ending December 31, 2026 (IFRS)
records.excerpt: Net sales increased by ¥31,626 million, or 14.4% year-on-year, to ¥250,813 million. Operating income increased by ¥7,874 million, or 50.9% year-on-year, to ¥23,352 million.
records.population: Nabtesco Group, continuing operations (hydraulic equipment business excluded)
records.does_not_establish: Group totals say nothing about how much revenue, if any, comes from individual buyers rather than businesses and institutions.

records.source_title: Precision Reduction Gears | Our Business | Nabtesco Corporation
records.excerpt: Thanks to their high reliability, Nabtesco’s precision reduction gears are preferred by a range of domestic and overseas robot manufacturers in the joints of their industrial robots, giving us a large share of the market. We have an approximately 60% (Nabtesco’s estimate) share of the global market for precision reduction gears when it comes to the joints of medium-size to large industrial robots.
records.population: Industrial robot manufacturers in Japan and abroad
records.does_not_establish: The share is the company's own estimate for medium-to-large industrial robots and says nothing about small, hobby or consumer robots.

records.source_title: Automatic Doors and Platform Screen Doors | Our Business | Nabtesco Corporation
records.excerpt: We hold roughly a 60% (Nabtesco’s estimate) share of the domestic market, and about a 20% (Nabtesco’s estimate) share of the global market, for automatic doors for buildings.
records.population: Buyers of automatic doors for buildings
records.does_not_establish: The shares are company estimates for building doors and do not show whether any of these doors are sold to households.

records.source_title: Automatic Doors and Platform Screen Doors | Our Business | Nabtesco Corporation
records.excerpt: These doors are used at a wide range of places, such as office buildings and public and commercial facilities. We have a proven track record also with industrial sites, such as factories and waste treatment facilities.
records.population: Office, public, commercial and industrial building owners
records.does_not_establish: It lists the building types served and does not mention private homes, which is not proof that none are supplied.

records.source_title: NABCOの事業拠点 | NABCOについて | ナブコ自動ドア
records.excerpt: 北海道から沖縄まで全国100ヶ所以上のサービスステーションを有し、販売・施工からアフターサービスまで常にお客様のご要望にお応えしております。
records.population: NABCO automatic door customers in Japan
records.does_not_establish: It does not say who the buyers are (contractors, building owners or households) or what a single small installation would cost.

records.source_title: Conpal - Assistive Products Department - Nabtesco
records.excerpt: It can be used from the initial stages of rehabilitation to the final stages. And it can also be used not only for rehabilitation in hospitals, but also for gait training at home.
records.population: Rollator users in rehabilitation and at home
records.does_not_establish: It shows intended home use of a wheel unit fitted to other makers' rollators, not how many units reach households or through which sellers.

records.source_title: Conpal - Assistive Products Department - Nabtesco
records.excerpt: Because The CONPAL unit is automatically activated, therapists’ feedback has been positive, with the effect of helping users to maintain a stable standing position and improve their posture.
records.population: Therapists working with people with Parkinson's disease and other gait instability
records.does_not_establish: The feedback is reported by Nabtesco without numbers or method and is not an independent evaluation of benefit or of willingness to pay.

records.source_title: 弊社ブランド製品のアフターサービス終了のご案内 (資料 No. 83SO30221)
records.excerpt: さて、2021 年 6 月に以下弊社ブランド製品（完成品）の販売を終了し、以降、補修部品の販売 および修理・点検作業のアフターサービスを提供して参りました。
records.population: Owners and dealers of Nabtesco-brand finished welfare products (CONPAL and REHAMO rollators, Assist Wheel power-assist wheelchairs, per the same notice)
records.does_not_establish: It does not give the reasons for ending sales of the finished products, their past sales volumes or whether they were profitable.

records.source_title: Welfare Equipment | Our Business | Nabtesco Corporation
records.excerpt: Nabtesco became the first in the world to develop a microprocessor-controlled intelligent prosthetic knee joint as mobility support equipment. The microprocessor detects the user’s walking speed, adjusts the pneumatic cylinder, and automatically controls the swing speed of the knee joint to help the person walk comfortably and naturally.
records.population: Above-knee amputees using prosthetic knee joints
records.does_not_establish: It describes the product but not how users obtain it (through prosthetists and public funding), its price, or unit sales.

records.source_title: アルクス2 - 福祉事業推進部 - ナブテスコ
records.excerpt: ALLUXを履くようになって安定性が良く、電子制御でアクティブに動けるようになったので、元気な子どもとも一緒に遊べる時間が増えて嬉しいです 。
records.population: An ALLUX prosthetic knee user (sports instructor)
records.does_not_establish: It is one testimonial chosen by the company and says nothing about how many users there are or what they paid.

records.source_title: Nabtesco Corporate Profile (issued February 2026)
records.excerpt: Our Monocrank™ Series of Compact Precision Reduction Gears boasts the high rigidity, load capacity, and reliability cultivated through our RV™ Precision Reduction Gears as well as a compact, lightweight design. These gears demonstrate their unique characteristics when used for the shoulder and hip joints of humanoid robots, thereby enabling consistent, slight movements.
records.population: Humanoid and collaborative robot makers
records.does_not_establish: It describes a component offered to robot makers and shows neither sales volumes nor any offer to individual builders or hobbyists.

records.source_title: ナブテスコ／重量物運搬の負担を80％以上軽減するアシストユニット発売 - LNEWS
records.excerpt: なお、製品は販売パートナー3社（ユーエイ：物流やモノづくりを支えるキャスター専門メーカー）、（カナツー：台車・キャスター・車輪など、物流機器全般の製造販売業者）、（大有：オーダーメイド仕様に特化したマテハン機械メーカー）を通じて販売する。
records.population: Logistics and manufacturing sites using hand carts
records.does_not_establish: It shows a business-to-business route for welfare-derived assist technology, not any demand from individual buyers.

records.source_title: 補装具費支給制度の概要 | 厚生労働省
records.excerpt: 障害者又は障害児の保護者が市町村長に申請し、身体障害者更生相談所等の判定又は意見に基づく市町村長の決定により、補装具費の支給を受ける。
records.population: People with disabilities who need prosthetics, wheelchairs, walkers and other assistive devices
records.does_not_establish: It sets out the public funding route but not how many prosthetic knees are funded each year or what share of Nabtesco's sales pass through it.

records.source_title: JIS A 4722:2022 歩行者用自動ドアセット－安全性 (preview)
records.excerpt: この規格は，製造業者の指示事項に基づき，専門業者が設置，保全及び点検を行うことを意図する自動 ドアセットを対象とする。
records.population: Power-operated pedestrian automatic door sets
records.does_not_establish: It does not say whether the standard is legally required or how it treats door openers sold for self-installation in private homes.

records.source_title: 消費者安全法第23条第1項の規定に基づく事故等原因調査報告書【概要】—自動ドアによる事故— (消費者安全調査委員会)
records.excerpt: 協会から入手した事故情報は、平均すると年130件程度報告され、図2に年度別の事故内訳を示す。 被災内訳は、骨折17件、裂傷81件、擦傷34件、打撲133件、その他172件であった。
records.population: Users of automatic sliding doors, mostly in shops and public buildings
records.does_not_establish: The counts cover doors in commercial and public settings and do not measure accident risk for doors in homes.

records.source_title: Global Sales of Professional Service Robots Surge 24% - International Federation of Robotics
records.excerpt: Consumer service robots have primarily consisted of domestic robots aimed at the mass market. Overall sales of consumer robots increased by 37% to almost 34.2 million units in 2025. Key trends include automating household tasks, integrating artificial intelligence and connecting to smart home systems.
records.population: Buyers of consumer service robots
records.does_not_establish: The IFR figures are sample-based, dominated by floor cleaners and mowers, and say nothing about consumer demand for precision gears or robot parts.

records.source_title: Global Sales of Professional Service Robots Surge 24% - International Federation of Robotics
records.excerpt: In 2025, about 7,000 units of full-size humanoids (above 140 cm) were sold globally. These robots are intended for commercial and professional applications beyond R&D and entertainment. Key challenges such as safety standards, high training and maintenance costs, and the lack of a strong business case, particularly in industrial settings, continue to limit widespread adoption.
records.population: Buyers of full-size humanoid robots
records.does_not_establish: It covers full-size humanoids for professional use and gives no figures for household or hobby humanoids or the gears inside them.

records.source_title: 開き戸タイプの玄関ドアを自動ドアに、LIXILの新規事業部門が1年で開発 - MONOist
records.excerpt: システム単体の価格（税別）は20万8000円から。同年8月3日から先行受注を開始し、9月1日から全国で発売する。基本的には、LIXIL製品の施工店経由での販売を想定しており、DOACが適用可能かどうかの確認やコンセントの設置などを含めた施工の期間は半日程度、費用は1万5000〜2万円を見込む。
records.population: Households with hinged front doors, sold through LIXIL installer shops
records.does_not_establish: It gives launch price and channel for a rival's home door opener but no sales volumes or profitability.

records.source_title: DOAC（ドアック）｜電動オープナーシステム｜LIXIL
records.excerpt: 「DOAC」の販売を26/4末をもって終了させていただきます。
records.population: Households considering a retrofit front-door opener
records.does_not_establish: It does not give the reason the product was withdrawn, so it cannot show that household demand was too small.

records.source_title: dormakaba - PORTEO
records.excerpt: An Innovative and integrated solution, ideal for homes High-quality dormakaba technology makes the PORTEO particularly easy to operate – with minimum noise, high functional reliability and excellent application adaptability.
records.population: Homes and people for whom interior swing doors are a barrier
records.does_not_establish: It shows a competitor markets a door operator for homes, not how much it sells, at what price or through which channel.

records.source_title: Record results for Ottobock: Double-digit growth, strong profit growth, positive outlook
records.excerpt: The development in the 2025 financial year has once again shown that the close integration of the two product categories Products & Components (B2B) and Patient Care (B2C) as an integrated platform is paying off. The Patient Care business grew by 8.3 percent (organic growth: 4.9 percent), while the Products & Components business grew by as much as 14.5 percent (organic growth: 15.2 percent).
records.population: Prosthetics users served through Ottobock's own patient care centers
records.does_not_establish: It shows a prosthetics rival runs a direct patient care business, not that Nabtesco could build or buy one, or at what return.

records.source_title: 歩行車 幸和製作所(TacaoF) ジスタR WAW35 - au PAY マーケット
records.excerpt: 後輪に抑速ブレーキ「pallu」搭載。 坂道などで一定速度を超えると自動でブレーキがかかり、下り坂も安心です。
records.population: Individual buyers of rollators online
